meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Recommended Supplier 1 Email" empty

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS with the two bids.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor B as specified.
Confirm the full line is selected for one of the two vendors before creating the proposal.
Open the proposal form after allocating the award.

args.goal: On the proposal form, fill every required field except Recommended Supplier 1 Email, leave that field empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop with the required-field validation visible

steps.note: Complete the company-specific proposal fields while deliberately omitting the target email field and submit the proposal.
Verify submission was refused because the Recommended Supplier 1 Email field is required.
